Package ai.niriksha.sdk

Class NirikshaAI

java.lang.Object
ai.niriksha.sdk.NirikshaAI
public final class NirikshaAI extends Object
Entry point for the NirikshaAI Java SDK.

Configures the OpenTelemetry Java SDK with OTLP gRPC exporters pointed at your NirikshaAI ingest endpoint, then registers the providers as globals so that all instrumentation libraries in the same JVM automatically export to NirikshaAI.

Quick start (SaaS)


 ShutdownHook hook = NirikshaAI.builder()
     .endpoint("https://app.niriksha.ai")
     .otlpEndpoint("grpc-ingest.niriksha.ai:443")
     .apiKey(System.getenv("NIRIKSHA_API_KEY"))
     .serviceName("my-service")
     .environment("production")
     .build();
 // ... your application ...
 hook.close(); // or use try-with-resources

Private Cloud (trusted CA)


 ShutdownHook hook = NirikshaAI.builder()
     .endpoint("https://niriksha.internal.example.com")
     .apiKey(System.getenv("NIRIKSHA_API_KEY"))
     .caCertFile("/etc/ssl/certs/internal-ca.pem")
     .serviceName("my-service")
     .build();

    • guardCheck

      public static GuardVerdict guardCheck(String text, String direction)
      Checks a prompt or completion.

      A redact verdict returns normally — use GuardVerdict.safeText(String) to get the text that is safe to send. Only a block throws, because a customer who asked for PII stripping wants their data protected, not their application broken.

      Parameters:
      text - the text to check
      direction - "input" for a prompt heading to the model, "output" for a completion coming back. Injection and jailbreak rules apply to input only; secrets and PII to both.
      Throws:
      GuardBlockedException - if the verdict is a block
      IllegalStateException - if the SDK has not been initialised yet

    • guardCheckTool

      public static GuardVerdict guardCheckTool(String name, String argumentsJson)
      Checks a tool call before executing it.

      This is the check that can actually prevent an action — an rm -rf, an unscoped DELETE, a credential read, an outbound request carrying a key. Observing the tool call afterwards cannot.

      Parameters:
      name - the tool being invoked
      argumentsJson - the arguments, already serialised as JSON. Pass null or empty to check the name alone.
      Throws:
      GuardBlockedException - if the verdict is a block
      IllegalStateException - if the SDK has not been initialised yet

    • guardCheckBatch

      public static GuardBatchResult guardCheckBatch(List<GuardBatchItem> items)
      Checks a whole message array in one request.

      A per-string API is an N+1 for a multi-turn conversation, which is every real chat application. At most 32 items.

      The returned action is the most severe of the set, because one blocked message means the conversation must not be sent.

      Throws:
      GuardBlockedException - if the aggregate verdict is a block
      IllegalStateException - if the SDK has not been initialised yet

    • localSecretFindings

      public static List<GuardFinding> localSecretFindings(String text)
